description: Attach a photo or PDF the person added to this chat onto a ticket. Pass the file itself as file. This works only where the chat app hands the file to the tool, as ChatGPT does; anywhere else, or for another kind of file, the answer is the ticket's link so the person can add it in the app. For something you wrote, use attach_file.

file.description: The file the person added to this chat

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: attach_upload
title: Attach a file the person added
